title: Freeze Time
description: Freeze time lets you toggle an orbit‑camera (I) and pick nearby entities to orbit, with filters and a preview.
body: Press I to open the freezetime orbit mode, it will have a selection of whatever mob is around the area including yourself so its basically freecam without having to control movement, the mob does! you can choose all Entitys so all monsters, passive mobs, and even entitys that arent a mob (e.g. Arrow, Minecarts of all variants, Tridents, Armor stands, Etc.)
